questions.prompt: What is a safe default for inserting untrusted plain text into a DOM element?
options: Use innerHTML for every value without validation.
Convert the input to a script element.
Put the input into an inline event-handler attribute.
Use textContent rather than interpreting the input as HTML.
questions.explanation: textContent treats a string as text and avoids parsing it as markup; validate input separately where appropriate.

questions.prompt: What should you remember about spread syntax on an object with nested objects?
options: The copy is shallow; nested object references can still be shared.
It always performs a deep clone.
It serializes the object to JSON.
questions.explanation: Spread copies enumerable own properties one level deep, so nested objects may still be aliased.
